name: genui
title: Generative UI
scope: Core work concerns AI generating or adapting the interface itself: layout, components, interactive workflows, or directly renderable UI structures. Evaluation of that generation can qualify. An agent/UI protocol qualifies only with an actual supported UI-generation/rendering contribution. Generic model/agent/MCP infrastructure, listicles and unsupported marketing do not qualify. A fixed interface using an LLM to generate content or chart specifications is adjacent unless interface generation/adaptation itself is a substantive contribution. VisCanvas is adjacent LLM-assisted visualization authoring in a fixed node canvas, not a core GenUI headline. Older foundational work can be dated background, never this week's new release.
